**Beşiktaş roll into Super Lig duty as massive favorites, but Eyüpspor's unbeaten run is no joke.** They're riding three straight wins and just drew with Fenerbahçe — this is a team with teeth, not a pushover. 🦷

Beşiktaş haven't dropped a game in pre-season and own the recent head-to-head completely, but Eyüpspor's blend of solidity and attacking spark makes them dangerous on the road. The Eagles should win, but don't sleep on the visitors testing them early.

Key storylines:

- **Beşiktaş's defensive wall** featuring T. Djaló and Y. Özcan will face a real test against A. Sy's pace and C. R. Yao's creativity
- **Eyüpspor's unbeaten streak** gives them confidence, but **Beşiktaş's home fortress** in the Tüpraş is a different beast entirely
- Midfield battle between **O. Kökçü and W. Nditi** versus **L. Pintor and I. Manga** will set the tempo

Expected lineups:

- **Beşiktaş JK**: D. Alemdar, I. Fakili, T. Djaló, Y. Özcan, O. Kökçü, W. Ndidi, V. Černý, S. Kilicsoy, J. Olaitan
- **Eyüpspor**: U. Keseci, Calegari, S. A. Yaşar, A. Yavuz, L. Pintor, I. Manga, T. Ilter, C. R. Yao, A. Sy

Prediction:

**Beşiktaş 2-0 Eyüpspor**

The Eagles have too much class and home advantage, but it'll take time to break through an organized Eyüp side. 🖤

**CSKA Sofia are absolutely rolling — Botev Vratsa are in deep trouble.** This is a mismatch on paper, and the head-to-head tells you everything you need to know. 🔴

CSKA have won three of their last five and just demolished Maccabi Tel Aviv away. Botev? They've lost three of their last four and shipped nine goals across those defeats. One team's got momentum, the other's got a crisis.

Key storylines:

- **CSKA's attack** keeps finding the back of the net — J. Zwarts and I. Pittas will be licking their lips against a leaky Vratsa defense
- **Botev's fragility** on the road is alarming — they've conceded five times in two recent away games
- **The home crowd advantage** is massive here; CSKA haven't dropped points at the Vasil Levski in this run

Expected lineups:

- **CSKA Sofia**: F. Lapoukhov, Á. Martino, A. Tunchev, T. Ivanov, Pastor, I. Solet, P. Panayotov, B. Jordão, V. Kaymakanov
- **Botev Vratsa**: L. Vasilev, S. Sanyang, L. Boyanov, A. Stoyanov, K. Hadji, I. Yurukov, M. Smolenski, M. Petkov, D. Genov

Prediction:

**CSKA Sofia 3–0 Botev Vratsa**

Expect a comfortable home win. Botev simply don't have the defensive solidity to survive this fixture. 🎯

**Lazio are rolling like a prestige machine, and Mantova's here to be a speed bump.** 🎯 The Biancocelesti have won five straight, while their Coppa Italia opposition are wobbling at 2W-3L in their last five—and that includes a heavy 6-2 win that masks real inconsistency.

Form tells the whole story: Lazio breezed past Frosinone and Ascoli on the road, then demolished Ostiamare 4-0 at home. Mantova dropped 0-1 to Carpi at theirs, so the gulf in momentum is real. This should be a cakewalk, but Coppa Italia can do weird things to big sides who aren't fully locked in.

Key storylines:

- **Lazio's attacking depth** will be on display with **Noslin** and **Cancellieri** leading the press

- **Mantova's defensive frailty** tested by a Lazio side that's scored at least two in every recent outing

- Early dominance could decide it; no reason Lazio shouldn't put this away before the hour mark

Expected lineups:

- **Lazio**: E. Motta, A. Marušić, N. Tavares, O. Provstgaard, A. Romagnoli, F. Dele-Bashiru, K. Taylor, R. Belahyane, M. Cancellieri, A. Przyborek, T. Noslin

- **Mantova**: F. Bardi, S. Cella, G. Fedel, A. Castellini, N. Radaelli, D. Wieser, S. Trimboli, L. Mancuso, F. Ruocco, D. Bragantini, D. Mensah

Prediction:

**Lazio 3-0 Mantova** — edge Lazio comfortably; expect them to kill it early and coast.

**Başakşehir rolls into the new season as heavy favorites against a Kocaelispor outfit that's barely scraped together a win in five.** The hosts' home advantage and **perfect H2H record** make this feel like a straightforward opening day for the Istanbul side. 🏟️

Başakşehir mixed results in pre-season — a couple of wins sandwiched around losses — but they're the clear quality step up here. Kocaelispor are winless in their last five and missing a defender in **A. Jovanović**, which only deepens their trouble against a slick attacking unit.

Key storylines:

- **Başakşehir's attacking depth** led by **E. Shomurodov** and **B. Yıldırım** should feast on a Kocaelispor backline thin on experience
- **Kocaelispor's struggle to score** — just one goal in their last three games — makes them a sitting duck on the road
- The absence of **A. Jovanović** leaves Kocaelispor's defense scrambling at the worst possible time

Expected lineups:

- **Başakşehir FK**: M. Şengezer, Ö. A. Şahiner, O. Ba, E. Bayram, J. Opoku, Y. Sarı, O. Kemen, E. Shomurodov
- **Kocaelispor**: S. Öztaşdelen, M. Cinan, A. Dijksteel, M. Haïdara, Show, H. Keita, D. Agyei, B. Petković

Prediction:

**Başakşehir 2-0 Kocaelispor** — the hosts lean on their dominance and superior fitness to cruise past a toothless visitor. ⚪

**Genoa looks to shake off those weird preseason vibes against Ascoli in what should be a routine Coppa Italia cruise.** 🏟️ The Rossoblu have the clear edge in pedigree, though recent form has been all over the map — a demolition at Bournemouth sandwiched around solid wins keeps things messy.

Ascoli's sitting on thin ice after dropping three of their last five, including losses to Frosinone and Lazio. They'll need a miracle to trouble a Serie A side hunting for rhythm in this competition.

Key storylines:

- **Genoa's depth** up front with Vitinha and L. Colombo will test an **Ascoli backline** that's been leaking goals

- B. Norton-Cuffy and the wingback system needs to click early; preseason jank dies fast in knockout rounds

- **Ascoli** can't afford to get chased — they need to stay compact and hope for a set-piece chance or counter


Expected lineups:

- **Genoa**: F. Stolz, D. Puczka, L. Østigård, M. Ellertsson, Vitinha, Amorim, F. Meichtry, B. Norton-Cuffy

- **Ascoli**: D. Barosi, S. D'Uffizi, A. Caucci, M. Alagna, S. Perciun, L. L. Scalzo, F. Palazzino, K. Gorica


Prediction:

**Genoa 2-0 Ascoli.** Clinical performance to advance; Ascoli puts up little fight. 💪

**Courage looking sharp and hungry; Dash trying to shake off a sluggish stretch.** North Carolina's rolling with three wins in their last five and are absolutely **clinical at home** — that 5-0 demolition of Orlando was serious business. Houston's been treading water (1W, 3D in their last five) and haven't found their rhythm yet. 🔥

The head-to-head leans Courage's way (5-4-1), and with **Courage's offensive firepower** vs **Dash's defensive fragility**, this feels like a mismatch on paper.

Key storylines:

- **Courage's attack** needs to keep its ruthless streak going — **E. Ijeh** and **L. Thompson** have been clinical finishers
- **Dash middleeld control** through **M. Graham** and **D. Colaprico** will be critical to slow North Carolina's tempo
- **Home advantage** at WakeMed is real; Courage are a different beast there

Expected lineups:

- **North Carolina Courage**: K. Sheridan, F. Rauch, M. Bell, U. Shiragaki, R. Williams, R. Jackson, D. Weatherholt, M. Matsukubo, A. Sanchez, L. Thompson, E. Ijeh
- **Houston Dash**: J. Campbell, L. Boattin, L. M. Klenke, P. Nielsen, A. Patterson, M. Graham, D. Colaprico, K. v. Zanten, L. Ullmark, K. Faasse, K. A. Rader

Prediction:

**Courage 2–0 Dash.** North Carolina's the clear favorite here — sharper form, home turf, and Houston just hasn't found gear yet.
